description: Two rule-based detectors fire on a mature, out-of-probation DID with perfect dimension scores: A1 circular endorsement (+0.30) and A2 cluster collusion (+0.40). p = min(1, 0.70) = 0.70, so S = round(100 x 1 x 0.30) = 30. Because p >= 0.5 the DID MUST additionally carry anomalyFlag = true in resolution metadata. Covers both the multiplicative discount and the flagging threshold.
